annotations.title: Get a registrar's status and enforcement history by IANA ID

description: Everything this register holds for one IANA registrar ID: accreditation status, RDAP base URL, and any ICANN breach, suspension or termination notice with the date and the notice PDF — each with its source page and a verbatim quote. Returns a LIST: ten IDs today carry two records because ICANN and IANA spell the registrar's name differently, and both are returned rather than one being chosen.

iana_id.description: The IANA registrar ID, e.g. "146" (GoDaddy) or "13".

name: get_registrar

accreditation_status.description: The status with the page that states it. null where neither page states one — which means the register does not say, NOT that the registrar is unaccredited.

also_reported.description: Values for this record reported by a SECOND source, each with its own source_url and source_quote. Cite these to the page they name, never to the record's primary source.

enforcement_action.description: Notice of Breach, Notice of Suspension or Notice of Termination.

enforcement_date.description: As ICANN prints it, e.g. "20 November 2017".

record_url.description: This record's own page on referencesource.org.

source_quote.description: Verbatim text from that page containing the value.

source_url.description: The page the value was read from.

title: Get a registrar's status and enforcement history by IANA ID
